label: Exposed — out of kegs, out of breath
location: The Palisade Camp, the empty feast ground
injuries: Lungs burning from smoke and shouting
An empty satchel where the quarry charges were

recentEvents.value: The last firework went up as a wall instead of a flower; the stranger saluted the exhaustion as evil revealing weakness.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Just stew, and songs, and us — and a man who wants none of it and takes all of it.

temporaryObjective.value: Say the plainest thing he knows and hope it lands once.

notes: 'Please… there is nothing here that belongs to you. Just stew, and songs, and us.'
